findings.claim: The brand radius scale is incomplete because no pill radius token is defined or exposed.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria/What Changes require a radius scale of `4/6/10/16/24/pill`, but the `@theme inline` radius block only defines `--radius-xs`, `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--radius-xl`, and `--radius-2xl`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add and expose a pill radius token, e.g. `--radius-pill: 9999px`, and map any intended pill utility to it.
